items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: That was another one of my friends. Yes. Harrison Bradley.

ctx.x: Vic Goss about two years. You mentioned some other trombonists that you liked or that helped you?
Some other trombone players that I liked that helped me was Harrison Bradley.
Oh yes, Harrison Bradley. That was my friend.

items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: My famous trombone player was Harrison Bradley.

ctx.x: That's what David's famous trombone player. Yeah, who was your favorite trombone player?
My famous trombone player was Harrison Bradley. Oh, yeah. And the next Albert Youngs, call him Boots.
Oh, yeah, that's Austin Young's brother.
